item.title: Fans who raised Greenland’s flag at US-Denmark Olympic hockey game say it was a pro-European gesture
item.description: Two fans who raised a flag of Greenland as the United States played Denmark in men’s hockey at the Winter Olympics say they did so as a gesture of European support for the island and for Denmark. Vita Kalniņa and her husband Alexander Kalniņš are fans of the Latvian hockey team who live in Germany. item.title: Bhatia’s big birdie runs helps him beat the wind and lead at Pebble Beach
item.description: Akshay Bhatia goes into the final round of the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am with a two-shot lead. He shot a 68 on Saturday with a big run of birdies on the scoring holes early. That gave him enough of a cushion to hold on when the cold wind arrived. Bhatia is up two over Jake Knapp, Collin Morikawa and Sepp Straka. The final hour was a prelude to Sunday. item.title: Adam Silver urges WNBA, players’ union to work faster on CBA negotiations to avoid a work stoppage
item.description: NBA Commissioner Adam Silver has called on the WNBA and its players’ association to increase their urgency to get a labor deal done in time for the new season to begin as scheduled in early May. Silver didn’t propose a deadline for a WNBA collective bargaining agreement in his annual address during NBA All-Star weekend, but he urged both sides to pick up the pace. item.description: UConn, UCLA, South Carolina and Vanderbilt would be the No. 1 seeds in the women’s NCAA Tournament if it began now. item.description: JT Toppin scored eight of his 31 points in a dominant overtime performance and No. 16 Texas Tech sent No. 1 Arizona to its second straight loss, shocking the Wildcats 78-75 on Saturday. item.title: ‘First feline’ Larry marks 15 years as Britain’s political top cat
item.description: Larry the cat is marking 15 years as Britain’s Chief Mouser at 10 Downing Street, a symbol of stability in turbulent political times. He reaches the milestone on Sunday, having served under six prime ministers. Larry is a former stray who was adopted in 2011 by then-Prime Minister David Cameron from the Battersea Dogs and Cats Home. item.title: Independent Spirit Awards celebrate indie movies and TV in Los Angeles
item.description: The Film Independent Spirit Awards shine a spotlight on indie movies and TV as stars like Ethan Hawke, Rose Byrne, and Keke Palmer compete for prizes.
